title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
backstory: King David has died, and his son Solomon now sits on his father's throne (1 Kings 2:10-12). Solomon feels far too small for the work: "I am but a little child," he prays, "I know not how to go out or come in" (1 Kings 3:7). Then at Gibeon God comes to him in a dream and says, "Ask what I shall give thee" (1 Kings 3:5) — and what this young king asks for will shape his whole reign.

passages.synopsis: Solomon loved the LORD and went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices. There God appeared to him in a dream by night and said, "Ask what I shall give thee." Solomon did not ask for long life or riches, but for an understanding heart to judge God's people. God was pleased, and gave him wisdom — and riches and honour besides.

Two mothers came to the king, each claiming the same living baby as her own. Solomon called for a sword and said to divide the child between them. The true mother cried out to spare the baby, even if it meant giving him up. Solomon gave her the child, and all Israel saw that the wisdom of God was in him.

Under Solomon's rule, Judah and Israel were as many as the sand by the sea, eating and drinking and rejoicing. Solomon reigned over all the kingdoms from the river to the border of Egypt. There was peace on every side all his days. Every man sat safely under his vine and his fig tree.

God gave Solomon wisdom and largeness of heart like the sand on the seashore. He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were a thousand and five. He spoke of trees, beasts, birds, and fishes. People came from every nation, and kings from all the earth, to hear his wisdom.

scrambleVerses.text: Ask what I shall give thee.
And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much
And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

triviaQuestions.question: What did Solomon ask God to give him at Gibeon?
triviaQuestions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:9 — "Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?"

triviaQuestions.question: How did Solomon reveal the true mother of the living child?
options: He commanded to divide the child with a sword
He asked the child to choose
He cast lots between the women
triviaQuestions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:25 — "And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other."

triviaQuestions.question: What did God give Solomon besides wisdom?
triviaQuestions.explanation: 1 Kings 3:13 — "And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days."

triviaQuestions.question: How many proverbs did Solomon speak?
triviaQuestions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:32 — "And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five."

reflection: Solomon could have asked God for anything, and he chose an understanding heart. If God asked you the same question tonight, what would you ask for?
